item.tib: kun tu bzang po 'khor ba stong bar 'dren pa'i ngan song dong sprug gi rgyud chen lung gi rgya mtsho'i don bsgom 'grel ba nyi 'od rgyan
item.coloph: rgyud 'grel rgyas pa pom ra shel brag la gter du sbas/ 'bring po dang ra khyung rdzong la gter du sbas/ bsdus pa ye shes mkha' 'gro la gnyer gtad bcol bas/ dus kyi mtha' la sngon gyi las dbang gis kun bzang gi zhal gzigs byin rlabs mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ kun bzang bla mas rgyud 'grel gzhung cha lag dang bcas pa'i lung gnang zhing dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs par nges med rnal 'byor bdag gis yi ger ris su bkod pa'i skabs su/ gzhan rkyen gyis 'jigs sngangs res blo la zhag (bzhag)pa brjed pa'i dus der/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma yis snyan rgyud du gnang ba yin no//
